item.title: Chapter 5: The Pelvis and Perineum
item.description: Chapter 5: The Pelvis and Perineum ATLAS REFERENCES G = Grant’s Atlas, 13th ed., page number L = LWW Atlas of Anatomy, 1st ed., page number N = Netter’s Atlas, 5th ed., plate number R = Color Atlas of Anatomy, 7th ed., page number C = Clemente’s Atlas, 6th ed., plate number The Pelvis and Perineum by three fused bones: pubis, ischium, and ilium. The point of fusion of these three bones is the acetabulum.
